title: Not Worth the Hype
text: Not Worth the Hype. Okay, let's really be honest with this. It's a cute idea and it looks cute when trying to use it for the first time but after that it's useless and honestly, I've never touched it since. It doesn't really work all that well and doesn't make the best cubes, which a knife works a lot better. As I said, it's fun for like a minute but then after that, it's just messy and doesn't really want to work that well and it's just not worth the hype.
